claims: West Virginia defeated Stanford 82-77 in overtime on April 2, 2026.
West Virginia vs Stanford game was in the College Basketball Crown quarterfinals.
West Virginia vs Stanford game was in Las Vegas.
Honor Huff scored eight points in overtime.
West Virginia advanced to the semifinals.
Ebuka Okorie scored 34 points for Stanford.
The game was tied 68-68 at the end of regulation.
West Virginia rallied from an eight-point deficit with 3:21 left in regulation.
Treysen Eaglestaff scored 18 points for West Virginia.
Brenen Lorient scored 14 points for West Virginia.
Aidan Cammann scored 12 points for Stanford.
AJ Rohosy scored 10 points for Stanford.
Benny Gealer fouled Honor Huff on a 3-point attempt with three seconds left in regulation.
Stanford made 1-of-7 field goals in overtime.
West Virginia advances to the semifinals on Saturday.
